_note: Bundles are named, ordered sets of skills that go together for one job. An entry with `recipe` points at a recipe in mcp/stack_recipes.json (the same sets the hive matches tasks against), and takes its name, goal and skills from there; the fields given here (purpose, when) are added. The others list their skills directly. Every skill must exist in the catalog (tests/test_library.py checks). Bundles of your own go in bundles.json in the hive's data folder (sfp_hive.py bundle-add).

bundles.when: A new page or screen that has to look right and work for everyone.
The UI works but the motion feels cheap or heavy.
You want an honest review of a finished interface.
A new feature in a React or Next.js app.
A new screen in a Flutter app.
A new feature in a Django project.
A new endpoint or service in FastAPI.
A new Go service or a change to one.
A backend service that is ready to go live.
Put an app in a container and deploy it.
A schema or query change on Postgres.
An app is about to face real users or an audit.
Building a plugin or skill for an agent.
Building an MCP server.
You are new to a codebase and need to understand it fast.
The problem is not understood yet.
Preparing to raise money.
Writing and publishing an article or post.

bundles.name: Add tests to legacy code
bundles.goal: Pin down what untested code does before you change it.
bundles.when: Code has no tests and you must change it.

bundles.name: Table-driven Go tests
bundles.goal: Cover a Go function with table-driven tests.
bundles.when: Writing tests for Go code.

bundles.name: End-to-end test suite
bundles.goal: Browser tests for the flows that matter, and a check that the buttons really do things.
bundles.when: A web app has no end-to-end coverage.

bundles.name: Accessible form
bundles.goal: A form that works with a keyboard and a screen reader and has clear messages.
bundles.when: Building or fixing a form.

bundles.name: Audit dependencies
bundles.goal: Find vulnerable packages and fix them without breaking the build.
bundles.when: Before a release or after a security notice.

bundles.name: Prepare a release
bundles.goal: Check, version, ship and watch a release.
bundles.when: A release is due.

bundles.name: Fix a bug properly

bundles.name: Speed up a React app
bundles.goal: Measure, then remove the slow parts.

bundles.name: Cut agent token spend
bundles.goal: Keep context small and the agent terse.
bundles.when: Sessions run out of context or cost too much.

bundles.name: Onboard to a codebase
bundles.goal: Map an unfamiliar repository before touching it.
bundles.when: First day on a project.

bundles.name: Market and competitor scan
bundles.when: Before a product or investment decision.

bundles.name: Documentation pass
bundles.goal: Docs that are current and findable, with decisions recorded.
bundles.when: Docs have drifted from the code.

bundles.name: Run an agent team
bundles.goal: Several agents working in a loop with checks.
bundles.when: A big task you want split across agents.

bundles.name: Memory across sessions
bundles.goal: Keep what was learned and find it again.
bundles.when: The agent keeps forgetting earlier work.

bundles.name: 3D and shader effects for the web
bundles.goal: A 3D scene or animated shader on a web page.
bundles.when: A hero section or product viewer with depth.

bundles.name: Write and promote
bundles.goal: An article in your voice, found by search, and shared.

bundles.name: Never run out of tokens
bundles.goal: Keep working when a model hits its limit: a free-tier router or gateway, routing rules, and budgets.

bundles.name: Find the right API
bundles.goal: Find a real free API for a need instead of guessing endpoints, then design the integration.
bundles.when: The task needs outside data and you do not know which API provides it.
